name: Organization Transfer
description: Transfer organization ownership from one principal to another. Requires quorum approval from organization admins, a configurable waiting period, and a final receipt.
purpose: Prevent unilateral hostile takeovers while enabling legitimate ownership transitions such as succession planning.
acceptanceCriteria: Transfer initiation: current owner initiates transfer to target principal
Quorum approval: N-of-M organization admins must approve before transfer proceeds
Waiting period: configurable delay between quorum approval and execution
During waiting period: any admin can veto the transfer
Transfer execution: ownership transferred, all owner-scoped capabilities reassigned
Transfer receipted with initiator, target, approvers, timestamps
Failure handling: expiry of waiting period without completion cancels the transfer
